topic_en: Actions are judged only by intentions
arabic_matn: عَنْ أَمِيرِ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَبِي حَفْصٍ عُمَرَ بْنِ الْخَطَّابِ رَضِيَ اللَّهُ تَعَالَى عَنْهُ قَالَ: سَمِعْتُ رَسُولَ اللَّهِ صَلَّى اللَّهُ عَلَيْهِ وَسَلَّمَ يَقُولُ: «إِنَّمَا الأَعْمَالُ بِالنِّيَّاتِ، وَإِنَّمَا لِكُلِّ امْرِئٍ مَا نَوَى، فَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى اللَّهِ وَرَسُولِهِ، وَمَنْ كَانَتْ هِجْرَتُهُ لِدُنْيَا يُصِيبُهَا أَوِ امْرَأَةٍ يَنْكِحُهَا فَهِجْرَتُهُ إِلَى مَا هَاجَرَ إِلَيْهِ».
narrator_ar: عمر بن الخطاب رضي الله عنه
english_translation: Actions are judged only by intentions, and every person will have only that which he intended. So whoever emigrated for the sake of Allah and His Messenger, his emigration is for Allah and His Messenger; and whoever emigrated for worldly benefit to attain or a woman to marry, his emigration is for that for which he emigrated.
benefits: Sincerity (Ikhlas) is the prerequisite foundation for the acceptance of all righteous actions.
Actions in Islam are evaluated and rewarded according to the internal motivation and intention of the heart.
A worldly habit can be transformed into rewarded worship with a noble intention.
